>> Capital is back — but highly selective <<

VALU Invest raised approximately EUR 80 million in equity and now has more than EUR 214 million available for established DACH SMEs.

The Godfather of AI, Nvidia reports its quarterly earnings tomorrow.

Investors are jittery as expected. The stock is down 4% over the last two weeks. The fundamental backdrop however remains strong. 

Hyperscaler capital expenditures surged 92% year-over-year and 29% quarter-over-quarter in the second quarter, marking the fastest expansion since late 2022. 

Cloud revenue across the Big 3 accelerated to 43% growth, with aggregate operating margins climbing to a record 39%. Against that spending wave, consensus models expect Nvidia revenue growth to moderate to 13% quarter-over-quarter, down from 20% or more in prior quarters.
